title: AgentRunBudgetAllocation
description: Immutable per-AgentRun resource ceiling layered under one shared WorkOrder ExecutionBudget ledger; topology limits are never copied here.
x-semantic-constraints: allocation_digest is RFC 8785 JCS SHA-256 over the allocation excluding allocation_digest

the root allocation has no parent and equals the resource fields of the WorkOrder ExecutionBudget; every child allocation references its parent allocation and is equal to or narrower than both parent and WorkOrder resource limits

all AgentRuns in the WorkOrder consume atomically from one PostgreSQL WorkOrder budget ledger keyed by work_order_budget_id; per-Run allocations never create independent copies of the shared hard ceiling

AgentRun count, depth and parallel admission use only max_agent_runs, max_agent_depth and max_parallel_agent_runs from the shared WorkOrder ExecutionBudget and are checked transactionally before a Child admission is accepted
